title: 3, 7, 14, 17, 42: Instruction Tuning Installs and Sharpens Number-Choice Heuristics in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We measure, without sampling error, the probability a language model assigns to each integer from 1 to N when asked for a random number. For a fixed prompt the model defines one probability vector, which we compute by summing over each integer's scored spellings rather than estimate by sampling, removing the noise that limits earlier studies [1, 4]. We evaluate 18 open-weight model lines at five ranges up to N = 100, under 29 decoding configurations, on two inference stacks; 15 of them have matched base and instruction-tuned checkpoints that both give usable answers. Instruction tuning makes the distribution less uniform in all 15 pairs. It installs one heuristic, round-number avoidance, and sharpens another, endpoint avoidance. Base checkpoints do not avoid round numbers once the endpoints are removed from those sets; tuned checkpoints avoid them, multiples of 10 almost completely. Base checkpoints return the endpoints 1 and N at 0.30 t

translated_title: 3、7、14、17、42：指令微调在语言模型中安装并强化数字选择启发式
translated_abstract: 我们以零抽样误差的方式测量了语言模型在被要求给出随机数时，赋予从1到N中每个整数的概率。对于固定提示，模型定义了一个概率向量，我们通过将每个整数各计分拼写的概率求和来精确计算该向量，而非通过抽样估计，从而消除了限制先前研究的噪声。我们在两个推理栈上、29种解码配置下、五个最大至N=100的数值范围内评估了18个开放权重模型系列；其中15个系列拥有配套的基础模型与指令微调检查点，且两者均能给出可用答案。在全部15对模型中，指令微调都使数字分布变得更不均匀。它安装了一种启发式——回避整数，并强化了另一种启发式——回避端点。一旦从候选集合中移除端点，基础模型检查点并不回避整数；而微调后的检查点则会回避整数，对10的倍数几乎完全回避。基础模型检查点返回端点1和N的概率为0.30 t（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过精确计算而非抽样估计的方法测量语言模型生成1到N随机数的完整概率分布，发现指令微调会安装“回避整数”并强化“回避端点”两种数字选择启发式，使分布更加不均匀。
en_tdlr: By exactly computing rather than sampling the probability a language model assigns to each integer when asked for a random number, this study shows that instruction tuning installs round-number avoidance and sharpens endpoint-avoidance heuristics, making the number-choice distribution less uniform.
